aiSummary:
CS2 skin market brief — monitored universe: 681 priced items. Over the last ~7 days, 304 rose (45.9%) and 358 fell (54.1%), so breadth looks soft / risk-off: decliners outnumber advancers over the trailing week [1].

Trading implication: focus on liquid majors and event-linked stickers/skins when volume expands, and avoid chasing illiquid knives/gloves on thin books [2]. Retrieved context highlights: Major windows often lift related sticker/skin turnover for 7–14 days, with post-event pullback risk [1].

Positioning note: size risk carefully around tournament calendars and post-event mean reversion. Skin markets are highly volatile — this is not investment advice.
